edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent source drawing for a shared front-facing game character rig. Edit ONLY the two gripping hands and the small wrist connections of this exact character. These hands are currently oriented identically; give them opposed anatomically plausible grips for a diagonal two-handed melee pole weapon. The character's LEFT hand, on the viewer's RIGHT at the upper chest-level grip, must be turned UPWARD in an underhand/supinated grip. The character's RIGHT hand, on the viewer's LEFT at the lower waist-level grip, must be turned DOWNWARD in an overhand/pronated grip. Make the difference clearly visible through thumb position and glove finger shape, not by swapping their heights. Preserve the exact grip centers (upper approximately x777 y459, lower x610 y598 on the reference), both elbow positions and all shoulder geometry. Keep the diagonal imaginary shaft passing lower-left to upper-right through both grips. Do NOT draw any weapon or imaginary shaft. Use rounded articulated charcoal gloves with simple grey highlights and individually readable fingers; no black square patches. Preserve this exact frontal outfit, helmet/hood, torso, pelvis, legs, feet, posture, proportions, all armor/sleeve colors, existing ink outlines and flat comic cel shading. Canvas and character size stay the same. No background, shadow, text, symbols, props or extra limbs. True transparent background.
